apps.name: spotifyglass
apps.subtitle: Liquid Glass for Spotify
apps.localizedDescription:
Spotify's own Liquid Glass design, unhidden from its feature flags, plus a pure black AMOLED background, a decluttered player and Home, a tab bar you can reorder or add your own links to, an editor for all of Spotify's internal flags, and telemetry blocking.

Purely cosmetic. It does not unlock Premium.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds an About section with the version, an update check and links.
